Task: Refine the UI structure, spacing, and alignment across UXMate to make the interface more sensible, readable, and visually consistent. 
The goal is not to redesign visually, but to reorganize elements so they look intentional, aligned, and easy to understand.

Apply the following improvements screen-by-screen:

----------------------------------------
GLOBAL CHANGES (APPLY EVERYWHERE)
----------------------------------------
1. Unify spacing tokens:
   - Use: 8px, 12px, 16px, 24px, 32px only.
   - Remove inconsistent gaps such as 6px, 10px, 14px.
   - Maintain vertical rhythm (consistent spacing between sections).

2. Improve typography hierarchy:
   - Section titles: 16px, semibold.
   - Labels: 12px, medium, muted color.
   - Body text: 14–15px, normal.

3. Align everything to a 4/8px grid. No odd spacing.

4. Increase contrast on muted text (current light grey is slightly too low contrast).

----------------------------------------
PROJECT HEADER (first screenshot)
----------------------------------------
- Align Title, Description, and Edit (✏️) icons perfectly in a vertical stack.
- Move the progress circle to the right side of the header for clarity.
- Add a faint divider below the header so sections feel properly separated.
- Ensure the two small edit icons have equal padding and consistent hit areas.

----------------------------------------
TABS: Notes / Checklist / Assets
----------------------------------------
- Increase horizontal spacing between tabs.
- Center tabs properly.
- Add a clearer active indicator (blue underline with radius).
- Reduce grey background inside tab container so tabs feel like pills, not blocks.

----------------------------------------
PROJECT NOTES PANEL
----------------------------------------
- Increase padding inside the notes card (currently feels “airless” at top).
- Align the “Saved” indicator to the far right, vertically centered.
- Add a better placeholder text with clearer guidance:
  “Start writing your problem statement, research notes, or findings here...”
- Ensure text input cursor starts with 16px inset padding.

----------------------------------------
PROJECTS SHEET (second screenshot)
----------------------------------------
- Increase spacing between project card and search bar.
- Project card:
  • Left: Title + Description + Date
  • Right: Action icons (duplicate, export, delete)
  • All icons must be 24px area and aligned in a row.
- Soft highlight on hover (desktop) or 4px shadow.
- Use curves consistently (14px radius, not random values).

----------------------------------------
TEMPLATES LIBRARY (third screenshot)
----------------------------------------
- Move the “All, Strategy, Research…” section to a pill bar with more spacing.
- Move “View Sample” button to align right (top-right of template card).
- Organize tags visually; they currently float inconsistently.
- Each template card should follow:
  Title (big)
  Subtitle (small)
  Tags row
  Preview box
  CTA button aligned full width.

----------------------------------------
NEW PROJECT MODAL (fourth screenshot)
----------------------------------------
- Move “Project Title” and “Description / Goal” labels slightly up (tighten spacing).
- Increase vertical spacing between text fields to 20px.
- Buttons row:
  • Left: Cancel (text button)
  • Right: Create Project (primary button)
  • Both aligned horizontally and centered vertically.

----------------------------------------
EXPORT MODAL (fifth screenshot)
----------------------------------------
- Improve FORMAT section:
  • Group “HTML Webpage” and “Print/PDF” options in a clear radio-block group.
  • Add icons to each block.
  • Show a short subtext explaining each option.
- Move “Include Assets” checkbox into a section titled “Options”.
- Add a thin divider between sections.
- Ensure Export button is full-width and fixed at the bottom for mobile usability.

----------------------------------------
AFTER APPLYING ALL CHANGES
----------------------------------------
Return:
- The list of files updated
- A 5-point summary of structural improvements made
- No visual restyling beyond alignment + spacing + clarity

**Revising UI Aesthetics**

Okay, I've got a grasp on the goal: improve UXMate's structure without a full visual overhaul. My analysis is complete. Now, I am evaluating the components and their layout, with an eye toward consistent spacing and alignment. My goal is to make the entire interface more readable. The theme stays the same, so this is about tuning the existing elements, not replacing them.


**Implementing New Structure**

I'm now zeroing in on the specific areas for improvement. I've broken down my observations and generated a task list. I'm focusing on unifying the spacing across the app, fixing typography issues, improving contrast, and aligning everything to a grid for better readability. I've noted specific changes for the header, tabs, notes panel, projects sheet, templates modal, new project modal, and export modal. The goal is to produce intentionality and consistency.


**Refining Specific Elements**

I'm now fully immersed in the nitty-gritty details. I've pinpointed precise modifications for specific components. For the Projects Sheet (Sidebar), I'm updating the project card layout, aligning icons better, and ensuring consistent spacing. The Header, Tabs, Notes Panel, and Assets (Workspace) are getting attention too – flex direction changes, pill styling tweaks, padding adjustments, and placeholder text updates are on the agenda. Also, I'm working on the Templates Modal and Create/Export Modals, focusing on category selector styling, card layout, and button alignment. My aim is a refined, cohesive UI.


**Enhancing Sidebar & Header**

I'm now implementing the refactored sidebar. I'm focusing on the project card updates, incorporating a flex row layout for clarity. I'm also addressing search bar spacing. In the Workspace Header, I'm adjusting the flex layout to improve visual flow, and I'm ensuring the progress ring is positioned correctly. I'm focusing on consistent padding and subtle visual cues to enhance the overall experience. I'm updating dividers and adjusting borders to refine the structure.


**Optimizing Modal Designs**

Right now, I'm focusing on the export and create project modals. I've standardized form spacing and label styles to be consistent. I'm tweaking button padding and input sizing. For the export modal, I'm adjusting the sidebar layout for better flow and spacing. I'm aiming for improved visual hierarchy and usability in these key interaction points.


**Fine-Tuning Header & Sidebar**

I'm now implementing the changes. I've switched the progress ring's position in the header, ensuring the title and description inputs still function correctly. In the sidebar, I'm verifying the project row height calculation to accommodate the new padding, and I'm updating text contrast for improved readability. I've added a border to the header for better visual separation. Finally, I'm refining the mobile tab section to improve usability.


**Adjusting Visual Harmony**

I'm now fully immersed in the details. I'm focusing on the `textarea` padding refinement, updating the `visibleProjects` mapping in `Sidebar.tsx`, and changing the project card layout to a Flex Row. I'm also ensuring icons are always visible on mobile and only on hover for desktop. The search input padding/margin are being adjusted as well. Next, I'm updating the grid card structure in `TemplatesModal.tsx` and moving the "View Sample" button. Finally, I'm updating form classes for the `CreateProjectModal.tsx` and redesigning the sidebar content in `ExportModal.tsx`.


**Implementing Layout Adjustments**

I'm now implementing the refined project sidebar content and adjusting the export modal radio block styles, keeping form spacing consistent. I'm focusing on ensuring the internal content fits within the defined project row height. My goal is to maintain the existing visual theme while improving the information hierarchy. I am adhering strictly to existing color palettes and rounded corners. My plan is to improve the Workspace.tsx header by switching to a flex row layout to optimize content display.


**Implementing Header Refinements**

I'm now implementing the Workspace.tsx header changes. I've switched to a `flex-row` layout. The goal is to ensure the header content optimally adapts to different screen sizes while keeping the progress ring fixed to the right. I'm focusing on ensuring the responsiveness and visual consistency of the header across all viewports.

entries.description: Refined sidebar project list for better spacing, alignment (Text Left, Icons Right), and contrast. Updated spacing tokens to be consistent (16px/20px).
Major structural cleanup of Workspace header (Layout alignment), Tabs (Spacing/Pills), and Notes (Padding/Contrast). Added dividers and refined typography.
Improved Templates Modal layout: Category pills, structured card layout (Title/Sub/Tags/Preview/CTA), and better spacing.
Adjusted spacing in create project modal: 20px vertical spacing, tighter labels.
Restructured Export Modal with Radio-Block style selection, cleaner option grouping, and dividers.
